hub.tagline: Every row and column has a target sum. Cross out numbers until every row and column matches — kept cells only.

all.title: Every row and column has a target
all.desc: The numbers along the right edge and bottom edge are the sums each row and column must reach — but only counting the cells you keep.

all.title: Tap a number to keep or cross it out
all.desc: Every cell starts kept. Tap one to cross it out of the sum, tap again to bring it back — the cell value never changes, only whether it counts.

all.title: Match every target to win
all.desc: Once every row's and every column's kept-cell sum matches its target, the board is solved. Stuck? Hint reveals one cell for you.

game.legend: tap a number to cross it out · tap again to keep it · edges show each target
game.hintFailToast: Every cell is already right where it should be.
game.winSubtitle: Every row and column landed on target — next board unlocked.
